idea: Practical: pick today's target from last session
caption: the simplest way to stop guessing

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid black, no photo
slides.text: one simple way to pick today's target from last session

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid lime, no photo
slides.text:
1. find last session's first set for this exercise.
example: 100 kg × 7

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid black, no photo
slides.text:
2. keep the weight and aim for one more rep.
example: 100 kg × 8

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid lime, no photo
slides.text: 3. hit the top of your rep range? add the smallest weight jump next time.

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid black, no photo
slides.text: 4. missed it? repeat the target. one session isn't a pattern.
EARND shows last session and today's target on every exercise.

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid black, no photo
slides.text:
last session. today's target. no guessing.
